# L578701ed vectors (time_m_1 + book_dwm dev_follow L=200 z=2.0), Asia

**RULE:** bars are TIME bars (every tick's own timestamp): not affected by print merging, so identical under every set family (`_CAN*`, `_CANQ`, `_CANR`, `_CANC`, `_CANG`: the BASE set is the number). Bar `time_m_1` = 1-minute bars anchored on the first print of the Asia session (18:00:00 ET), known at the minute boundary; the NT8 native 1-minute bar has the same grid. `tm60` (epoch-aligned, used by L7f41b347/Lcbc8a7ec) has identical OHLCV but is known at the first print of the next minute.

Set families and what each used: `_CAN` = records merged on the same millisecond + side (tape flag) + price, ms-truncated stamps (superseded); `_CANQ` = contract-level prints (each contract one print), side last-vs-bid/ask (superseded, reference); `_CANR` = run merge + last-vs-bid/ask, first-record stamp (look-ahead, reference); `_CANC` = run merge + last-vs-bid/ask, causal close (next different print); `_CANG` = 1 s-cap run merge, causal close.

## Trigger inputs
book_dwm: at each bar close, x = DWM deviation in TICKS = (bid-size-weighted average price over 10 bid levels + ask-size-weighted average price over 10 ask levels)/2 minus (best bid + best ask)/2, from the last valid book snapshot at or before the bar's known time (100 ms grid, engine). sd200 = sample std (ddof 1) of x over the last 200 one-minute bars of the continuous series (min 66); z = x/sd200; LONG when z >= 2.0, SHORT when z <= -2.0, edge-triggered. Stored x is float16-rounded (engine feature store). Rule: D8_TRIGGER_DEFS.md 3.12, D8_FEED_CHECK.md section 4.
